description: Address generator playing one of 100 stored sixteen-step orders, with an offset, a direction and an address space of 2 to 32 steps

params.text: Picks which of the 100 sixteen-step orders is played
Adds to every step number before it is put out, 0 to 15 steps
Runs the order forwards or backwards
Sets how many steps the address space holds, 2 to 32; use 16 to address TD4

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves on to the next step of the order
A rising edge returns to the first step of the order and blocks the clock for 1ms
Selects the order, 0.1V per order over 0-10V, and overrides the pattern selector while patched
Sets the offset, 1.6 steps per volt over 0-10V, overrides the Ofs knob while patched, and restarts the order whenever it changes the offset
Runs the order backwards at 5V and above and forwards below that, and overrides the switch while patched

outputs.text: The current step as a voltage, with the whole address space spread over 0-10V

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 5V · stepped · one channel only
